title: Spencer’s portfolio · geometry and motion
question: Confirmed direction: precise 3D geometry, animated typography, soft charcoal/red, and experience before projects. These three images compare compositions within that direction. Pick one or describe what to combine.

options.label: A · Balanced surface
options.thesis: A clear professional introduction beside a responsive parametric surface.
options.viewport: Introduction left, surface right; experience and résumé immediately beneath, projects later.
options.risk: The surface needs careful scale to keep experience prominent.

options.label: B · Panoramic field
options.thesis: A broad geometric landscape adds depth above an experience-led layout.
options.viewport: Short broad spatial hero, prominent wide experience section, then projects.
options.risk: The immersive background needs a clear quiet region behind text.

options.label: C · Spatial viewport
options.thesis: An engineered 3D loop gives the introduction a defined focal point.
options.viewport: Introduction beside geometric sculpture; experience first, project previews below.
options.risk: A contained object feels less immersive than a full background.
